QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Jammed
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Cygnus Soldier on Ship Deck 2. He will tell you what you need to do.
QuestInfo.1:
The soldier told you that the monsters on the ship decks must be cleared out.
You can enter through the portal on the right of Ship Deck 2.
When you are done, return to Ship Deck 1 and talk to Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.2: Talk to Grendel the Really Old on Ship Deck 1.

npc.0: Help with the battle on the ship decks.

quest.0: Help out on Ship Decks 4, 5, and 6.\r\nYou can enter through the portal on the right of Ship Deck 2.
